description: This file defines structures and function declarations related to managing 'packed-refs' in a version control system, likely Git. It provides an interface for initializing, locking, unlocking, and querying packed reference stores.

methods.name: packed_ref_store_init
methods.description: Initializes a packed reference store for a given repository and git directory with specific store flags.

methods.name: packed_refs_lock
methods.description: Locks the packed-refs file for writing, returning 0 on success or an error on failure.

methods.name: packed_refs_unlock
methods.description: Unlocks the packed-refs file for writing.

methods.name: packed_refs_is_locked
methods.description: Checks if the packed-refs file is currently locked.

methods.name: packed_refs_size
methods.description: Retrieves the size of the packed-refs file, or 0 if the file does not exist.

methods.name: is_packed_transaction_needed
methods.description: Determines whether a transaction on the packed refs store is necessary, given the current state.
